title: NAIMA: Semantics Aware RGB Guided Depth Super-Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2604.04407v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Guided depth super-resolution (GDSR) is a multi-modal approach for depth map super-resolution that relies on a low-resolution depth map and a high-resolution RGB image to restore finer structural details. However, the misleading color and texture cues indicating depth discontinuities in RGB images often lead to artifacts and blurred depth boundaries in the generated depth map. Recent methods counter this by drawing priors from large pretrained models, but these priors enter the network as decoded predictions such as relative depth, surface normal, or segmentation maps, coupling restoration quality to the accuracy of the decoded prior and requiring auxiliary objectives. We propose a solution that introduces global contextual semantic priors, generated from pretrained vision transformer token embeddings, injecting them directly into the depth branch. translated_title: NAIMA：语义感知的RGB引导深度超分辨率
translated_abstract: 引导深度超分辨率（GDSR）是一种多模态方法，用于深度图超分辨率，它依赖低分辨率深度图和高分辨率RGB图像来恢复更精细的结构细节。然而，RGB图像中指示深度不连续性的误导性颜色和纹理线索往往导致生成深度图中的伪影和模糊的深度边界。近期方法通过从大型预训练模型中提取先验来应对这一问题，但这些先验作为解码后的预测（如相对深度、表面法线或分割图）进入网络，将恢复质量与解码先验的准确性耦合，并需要辅助目标。我们提出一种解决方案，引入从预训练视觉变换器标记嵌入生成的全局上下文语义先验，直接将其注入深度分支。我们的引导标记注意力（GTA）模块允许多级深度编码作为查询来整合这些语义先验，从而增强深度结构恢复，无需额外解码目标。
tldr: 本文提出一种语义感知的RGB引导深度超分辨率方法，通过预训练视觉变换器标记嵌入生成全局语义先验，并利用引导标记注意力模块直接注入深度分支，避免依赖解码先验的辅助目标，从而提升深度恢复质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a semantics-aware RGB-guided depth super-resolution method that injects global contextual semantic priors from pretrained vision transformer token embeddings directly into the depth branch via a Guided Token Attention module, avoiding auxiliary decoding objectives and improving depth restoration quality.
